title: Don't Use Excel's New Multi-Value Cells Yet #excel #shorts
description: Excel's new lists and arrays in cells are exciting, but Microsoft's current Beta documentation lists important limitations: Power Query does not load or emit array-valued columns, PivotTables do not read them as source data, charts do not expand them into data points, and data validation cannot use them as dropdown items. #excel #exceltips #microsoft365 #shorts
visual_style: premium warning-style realistic Excel demo with brief cinematic analyst desk B-roll; precise callouts; no fake UI
research_signal: Contrarian follow-up to a fresh feature: excitement plus concrete Beta limitations creates strong curiosity and trust.
hook: Excel's new multi-value cells look amazing. But I would not use them in an important workbook yet.
CTA: The full breakdown is on FlowMinute Lab.
